title: Script the launcher's live Herdr probe
body:
Outcome: one command proves a successor-launch change against the real Herdr: it creates a scratch shell tab, runs scripts/claude/successor-launch.ts there with an untrusted scratch cwd (the successor holds on Claude's folder-trust dialog and spends no tokens), prints the launcher's stdout, stderr and exit plus the successor's `herdr agent get` status as one verdict line, and closes both tabs; it never runs the launcher from the caller's own pane.
Evidence: t-tdkpgag (#361), t-p4akh87 (#364) and t-g1cwxm2 (#369) each hand-built this probe from a task body (herdr tab create, pane run, a polling loop, two tab closes). Run from the lead's pane instead, the probe renames the lead's tab and the probe successor's --retire closes the lead pane once idle.
Proof: a test drives the probe's Herdr calls through a stub serving the verbatim captures in test/fixtures/herdr and asserts both tabs close on every exit path; one live run prints the verdict with `agent claude blocked`, exit 0, and leaves no probe tab.
